# Greyburn Freight - September dispatch log

One row per dispatch note as booked at the dock. status is the
in-house system state of the note; what counts toward the monthly
depot standings is set in notes/ops-memo.txt.
files.notes/ops-memo.txt:
Night ops memo - standing exclusions

Depot throughput counts dispatch notes in state CLEARED
only. Notes still in state QA-HOLD sit with the quality
queue and are left out of the depot standings until the
release note is countersigned.
